id-20260910-news-2.title: Rupiah Surges to Become Asia's Strongest, Markets Now Keep Eyes on External Debt Data and BI Board of Governors Meeting in Late September

segments.src: Nilai tukar rupiah mencatatkan performa impresif pada perdagangan 9 September 2026.
segments.tr: The rupiah exchange rate recorded an impressive performance in trading on September 9, 2026.

segments.src: Mata uang Garuda menguat 121 poin dan ditutup di level Rp17.511 per dolar Amerika Serikat, menjadikannya salah satu mata uang dengan penguatan terbaik di kawasan Asia pada hari itu.
segments.tr: The Garuda currency strengthened by 121 points and closed at the level of Rp17,511 per US dollar, making it one of the currencies with the best gains in the Asian region that day.

segments.src: ## Penguatan di Tengah Dinamika Pasar Global
segments.tr: ## Strengthening Amid Global Market Dynamics

segments.src: Penguatan rupiah tidak lepas dari sejumlah faktor yang saling berkaitan.
segments.tr: The rupiah's strengthening is inseparable from a number of interrelated factors.

segments.src: Pelemahan indeks dolar AS akibat ekspektasi pasar terhadap arah kebijakan moneter bank sentral Amerika Serikat menjadi salah satu pendorong utama aliran modal ke aset-aset di pasar berkembang, termasuk Indonesia.
segments.tr: The weakening of the US dollar index due to market expectations regarding the direction of the US central bank's monetary policy became one of the main drivers of capital flows into assets in emerging markets, including Indonesia.

segments.src: Selain itu, sentimen positif terhadap prospek ekonomi domestik turut memberi ruang bagi penguatan rupiah.
segments.tr: In addition, positive sentiment towards domestic economic prospects also provided room for the rupiah to strengthen.

segments.src: Beberapa analis pasar menilai bahwa kombinasi antara arus masuk investasi portofolio dan stabilitas kondisi makroekonomi dalam negeri menjadi penopang tambahan bagi mata uang Garuda di tengah fluktuasi pasar global yang masih terus berlangsung.
segments.tr: Several market analysts consider that the combination of portfolio investment inflows and domestic macroeconomic stability serves as an additional support for the Garuda currency amid ongoing global market fluctuations.

segments.src: Meski demikian, pelaku pasar tetap mengingatkan bahwa pergerakan nilai tukar bersifat dinamis dan dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu mengikuti perkembangan data ekonomi maupun sentimen global terbaru.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, market participants continue to remind that exchange rate movements are dynamic and can change at any time following the latest economic data developments or global sentiments.

segments.src: ## Dua Agenda Penting yang Dinanti Pasar
segments.tr: ## Two Important Agendas Awaited by the Market

segments.src: Setelah momentum penguatan ini, perhatian pelaku pasar kini beralih ke sejumlah agenda penting yang berpotensi memengaruhi arah pergerakan rupiah dalam beberapa pekan mendatang.
segments.tr: Following this strengthening momentum, market attention is now turning to a number of important agendas that have the potential to influence the direction of the rupiah's movement in the coming weeks.

segments.src: Rilis Data Utang Luar Negeri (ULN) Juli 2026**
segments.tr: Release of External Debt (ULN) Data for July 2026**

segments.src: Bank Indonesia dijadwalkan merilis data statistik utang luar negeri untuk periode Juli 2026 pada 15 September 2026.
segments.tr: Bank Indonesia is scheduled to release external debt statistical data for the July 2026 period on September 15, 2026.

segments.src: Data ini menjadi salah satu indikator penting yang biasa dicermati pelaku pasar untuk menilai ketahanan eksternal perekonomian nasional, termasuk komposisi utang pemerintah maupun swasta serta rasio utang terhadap produk domestik bruto (PDB).
segments.tr: This data is one of the important indicators commonly observed by market participants to assess the external resilience of the national economy, including the composition of government and private debt as well as the debt-to-gross domestic product (GDP) ratio.

segments.src: Rapat Dewan Gubernur (RDG) Bank Indonesia**
segments.tr: Bank Indonesia Board of Governors Meeting (RDG)**

segments.src: Agenda berikutnya yang tak kalah dinanti adalah hasil Rapat Dewan Gubernur Bank Indonesia yang dijadwalkan berlangsung pada 23 September 2026.
segments.tr: The next agenda that is no less awaited is the result of the Bank Indonesia Board of Governors Meeting scheduled to take place on September 23, 2026.

segments.src: Keputusan mengenai suku bunga acuan BI-Rate dalam pertemuan tersebut akan menjadi salah satu faktor kunci yang dapat memengaruhi daya tarik instrumen investasi berbasis rupiah, sekaligus memberi sinyal arah kebijakan moneter Indonesia ke depan.
segments.tr: The decision regarding the BI-Rate benchmark interest rate in that meeting will be one of the key factors that can influence the attractiveness of rupiah-based investment instruments, while signaling the direction of Indonesia's monetary policy going forward.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Diperhatikan Pelaku Pasar
segments.tr: ## What Market Participants Need to Pay Attention To

segments.src: Kombinasi antara data eksternal dan keputusan kebijakan moneter domestik ini berpotensi menjadi katalis penting bagi pergerakan rupiah dalam jangka pendek.
segments.tr: The combination of external data and domestic monetary policy decisions has the potential to be an important catalyst for rupiah movements in the short term.

segments.src: Pelaku pasar, mulai dari investor institusi hingga individu, disarankan untuk terus memantau perkembangan data ekonomi baik dari dalam maupun luar negeri sebagai bahan pertimbangan.
segments.tr: Market participants, ranging from institutional investors to individuals, are advised to continue monitoring economic data developments from both domestic and foreign sources as a consideration.

segments.src: Perlu diingat bahwa pergerakan nilai tukar dipengaruhi oleh banyak variabel yang kompleks dan dapat berubah secara cepat.
segments.tr: It should be remembered that exchange rate movements are influenced by many complex variables and can change rapidly.

segments.src: Artikel ini disajikan sebagai informasi umum mengenai perkembangan pasar keuangan dan bukan merupakan rekomendasi atau saran investasi.
segments.tr: This article is presented as general information regarding financial market developments and does not constitute an investment recommendation or advice.

segments.src: Sebelum mengambil keputusan finansial, pembaca disarankan untuk melakukan analisis lebih lanjut atau berkonsultasi dengan penasihat keuangan yang berkompeten.
segments.tr: Before making financial decisions, readers are advised to conduct further analysis or consult with a competent financial advisor.

id-20260910-news-1.title: Prabowo Sends Off 430 Athletes to the 2026 Asian Games, Promises IDR 3 Billion Bonus for Gold Medalists

segments.src: Presiden Prabowo Subianto secara resmi melepas kontingen Indonesia yang akan berlaga di ajang Asian Games XX Aichi-Nagoya 2026.
segments.tr: President Prabowo Subianto has officially sent off the Indonesian contingent that will compete in the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games XX.

segments.src: Sebanyak 430 atlet dijadwalkan turun di 35 cabang olahraga, menjadikan kontingen kali ini salah satu yang terbesar dalam sejarah keikutsertaan Indonesia di pesta olahraga multievent tingkat Asia tersebut.
segments.tr: A total of 430 athletes are scheduled to compete in 35 sports, making this contingent one of the largest in the history of Indonesia's participation in the Asian-level multi-sport event.

segments.src: ## Pelepasan Kontingen dan Harapan Presiden
segments.tr: ## Contingent Send-off and Presidential Hopes

segments.src: Dalam acara pelepasan, Presiden menyampaikan dukungan penuh pemerintah terhadap perjuangan para atlet dan menekankan pentingnya semangat sportivitas serta kerja keras selama masa persiapan.
segments.tr: During the send-off ceremony, the President conveyed the government's full support for the athletes' efforts and emphasized the importance of sportsmanship and hard work during the preparation period.

segments.src: Ia juga menitipkan harapan agar kontingen Merah Putih dapat tampil maksimal dan mengharumkan nama bangsa di kancah Asia.
segments.tr: He also expressed his hope that the Red and White contingent would perform at their best and bring honor to the nation on the Asian stage.

segments.src: Kontingen Indonesia akan bersaing dengan atlet-atlet dari puluhan negara Asia lainnya di berbagai cabang olahraga, mulai dari cabang unggulan yang selama ini menjadi andalan perolehan medali, hingga cabang-cabang baru yang mulai dikembangkan oleh induk organisasi olahraga nasional.
segments.tr: The Indonesian contingent will compete against athletes from dozens of other Asian countries in various sports, ranging from flagship disciplines that have traditionally been reliable sources of medals, to new sports that are being developed by national sports governing bodies.

segments.src: ## Bonus Rp3 Miliar per Medali Emas
segments.tr: ## IDR 3 Billion Bonus per Gold Medal

segments.src: Salah satu poin yang menjadi sorotan dalam acara pelepasan adalah janji pemberian bonus bagi atlet peraih medali.
segments.tr: One of the highlights of the send-off ceremony was the promise of bonuses for medal-winning athletes.

segments.src: Pemerintah menjanjikan bonus sebesar Rp3 miliar untuk setiap medali emas yang berhasil diraih, jumlah yang disebut tiga kali lipat lebih besar dibandingkan bonus yang diberikan pada ajang SEA Games.
segments.tr: The government has promised a bonus of IDR 3 billion for every gold medal won, an amount described as three times larger than the bonus given at the SEA Games.

segments.src: Kenaikan nilai bonus ini dipandang sebagai bentuk apresiasi sekaligus dorongan motivasi bagi para atlet, mengingat tingkat persaingan di Asian Games jauh lebih ketat dibandingkan ajang regional Asia Tenggara.
segments.tr: This increase in the bonus value is seen as a form of appreciation as well as a motivational boost for the athletes, considering that the level of competition at the Asian Games is far tighter than at the Southeast Asian regional event.

segments.src: Skema bonus untuk peraih medali perak dan perunggu turut disiapkan, meski nominal untuk emas menjadi perhatian utama publik karena besarannya yang signifikan.
segments.tr: Bonus schemes for silver and bronze medalists are also being prepared, although the amount for gold remains the primary focus of public attention due to its significant value.

segments.src: ## Persiapan Menuju Aichi-Nagoya 2026
segments.tr: ## Preparations for Aichi-Nagoya 2026

segments.src: Asian Games XX yang akan digelar di Aichi dan Nagoya, Jepang, pada 2026 diproyeksikan mempertemukan ribuan atlet dari seluruh Asia.
segments.tr: The Asian Games XX, which will be held in Aichi and Nagoya, Japan, in 2026, is projected to bring together thousands of athletes from across Asia.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, ajang ini menjadi kesempatan untuk mempertahankan tren positif capaian medali pada edisi-edisi sebelumnya, sekaligus menjadi ajang uji coba menuju kompetisi multievent yang lebih besar di masa mendatang.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, this event is an opportunity to maintain the positive trend of medal achievements from previous editions, while also serving as a testing ground for larger multi-sport competitions in the future.

segments.src: Federasi olahraga nasional bersama Kementerian Pemuda dan Olahraga disebut telah menjalankan program pemusatan latihan secara intensif dalam beberapa bulan terakhir untuk memastikan kesiapan fisik dan teknis para atlet sebelum bertanding.
segments.tr: National sports federations, together with the Ministry of Youth and Sports, are said to have been running intensive training camp programs over the past few months to ensure the physical and technical readiness of the athletes before competing.

segments.src: ## Dukungan Publik dan Ekspektasi
segments.tr: ## Public Support and Expectations

segments.src: Pelepasan kontingen ini turut mendapat perhatian luas dari masyarakat, terutama pencinta olahraga tanah air yang berharap Indonesia mampu meningkatkan capaian dibandingkan edisi Asian Games sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The send-off of this contingent has also received widespread attention from the public, especially sports fans in the country who hope that Indonesia can improve its achievements compared to the previous edition of the Asian Games.

segments.src: Dengan dukungan insentif yang lebih besar, para atlet diharapkan dapat tampil dengan motivasi tinggi dan memberikan hasil terbaik bagi Indonesia di kancah olahraga Asia.
segments.tr: With greater incentive support, athletes are expected to perform with high motivation and deliver the best results for Indonesia on the Asian sports stage.

id-20260910-news-3.title: Third Day of Search for 8 Missing People in the Sunda Strait, Joint SAR Team Combs Waters North of Anak Krakatau

segments.src: Operasi pencarian dan pertolongan (SAR) terhadap delapan orang yang hilang kontak di perairan Selat Sunda memasuki hari ketiga, namun hingga kini belum membuahkan hasil.
segments.tr: The search and rescue (SAR) operation for eight people who lost contact in the waters of the Sunda Strait has entered its third day, but so far, it has not yielded any results.

segments.src: Delapan orang tersebut terdiri dari lima jurnalis dan tiga kru kapal cepat (speedboat) yang dilaporkan kehilangan kontak sejak Senin (7/9) saat melakukan peliputan aktivitas erupsi Gunung Anak Krakatau.
segments.tr: The eight people consist of five journalists and three speedboat crew members who were reported to have lost contact since Monday (7/9) while covering the eruption activity of Mount Anak Krakatau.

segments.src: ## Kronologi Singkat
segments.tr: ## Brief Chronology

segments.src: Berdasarkan informasi yang dihimpun, rombongan berangkat menggunakan speedboat untuk mendekati kawasan Gunung Anak Krakatau guna mengambil gambar dan video aktivitas vulkanik yang tengah meningkat.
segments.tr: Based on gathered information, the group departed using a speedboat to approach the Mount Anak Krakatau area to take pictures and videos of the increasing volcanic activity.

segments.src: Komunikasi dengan kapal terputus di tengah perjalanan, dan hingga waktu yang dijadwalkan kapal tidak kunjung kembali ke titik keberangkatan.
segments.tr: Communication with the boat was lost mid-journey, and by the scheduled time, the boat had not returned to the point of departure.

segments.src: Pihak keluarga dan instansi terkait kemudian melaporkan kejadian tersebut kepada otoritas SAR setempat.
segments.tr: The families and relevant agencies then reported the incident to the local SAR authorities.

segments.src: ## Tim Gabungan Diterjunkan
segments.tr: ## Joint Team Deployed

segments.src: Menanggapi laporan tersebut, tim gabungan yang terdiri dari Badan SAR Nasional (Basarnas) Kantor Pencarian dan Pertolongan Banten, unsur TNI, dan Polri langsung dikerahkan untuk melakukan pencarian di sekitar lokasi terakhir speedboat terdeteksi.
segments.tr: Responding to the report, a joint team consisting of the National Search and Rescue Agency (Basarnas) Banten Search and Rescue Office, elements of the TNI (Indonesian National Armed Forces), and the National Police was immediately deployed to conduct a search around the last location where the speedboat was detected.

segments.src: Area pencarian difokuskan pada perairan di sisi utara Gunung Anak Krakatau, mengikuti perkiraan arah arus dan titik komunikasi terakhir yang tercatat.
segments.tr: The search area is focused on the waters on the north side of Mount Anak Krakatau, following the estimated direction of the current and the last recorded communication point.

segments.src: Proses pencarian melibatkan kapal patroli, perahu karet, serta personel yang disiagakan di sepanjang jalur perairan yang dianggap berpotensi menjadi lokasi keberadaan korban maupun bangkai kapal.
segments.tr: The search process involves patrol boats, rubber boats, and personnel stationed along the water routes considered potential locations for the victims or the wreckage of the boat.

segments.src: ## Kendala di Lapangan
segments.tr: ## Challenges in the Field

segments.src: Tim SAR menghadapi sejumlah tantangan selama proses pencarian berlangsung.
segments.tr: The SAR team has faced a number of challenges during the search process.

segments.src: Gelombang laut yang tergolong tinggi di wilayah Selat Sunda menyulitkan pergerakan kapal pencari, sementara sebaran abu vulkanik akibat aktivitas Anak Krakatau turut membatasi jarak pandang di area pencarian.
segments.tr: High sea waves in the Sunda Strait region have hindered the movement of search vessels, while the spread of volcanic ash due to Anak Krakatau's activity has also limited visibility in the search area.

segments.src: Kondisi cuaca yang tidak menentu membuat tim harus menyesuaikan strategi penyisiran secara berkala demi menjaga keselamatan personel yang terlibat.
segments.tr: Unpredictable weather conditions have forced the team to adjust their sweeping strategy periodically to ensure the safety of the personnel involved.

segments.src: Hingga laporan ini disusun, otoritas SAR menyatakan bahwa hasil pencarian pada hari ketiga masih nihil dan belum ditemukan tanda-tanda keberadaan delapan orang yang hilang tersebut.
segments.tr: As of the time this report was compiled, SAR authorities stated that the results of the search on the third day remain nil, and no signs of the eight missing people have been found.

segments.src: ## Langkah Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Next Steps

segments.src: Pihak berwenang menegaskan bahwa operasi pencarian akan terus dilanjutkan pada hari-hari berikutnya dengan memperluas area penyisiran serta melibatkan lebih banyak alat bantu, termasuk pemantauan dari udara apabila kondisi cuaca memungkinkan.
segments.tr: Authorities emphasized that the search operation will continue in the following days by expanding the sweeping area and involving more auxiliary equipment, including aerial monitoring if weather conditions permit.

segments.src: Koordinasi antara Basarnas, TNI, Polri, serta pihak terkait lainnya terus diperkuat guna mempercepat proses evakuasi jika korban ditemukan.
segments.tr: Coordination between Basarnas, the TNI, the National Police, and other relevant parties continues to be strengthened to accelerate the evacuation process if the victims are found.

segments.src: Keluarga korban serta rekan-rekan jurnalis yang tergabung dalam berbagai organisasi pers turut memantau perkembangan pencarian dan berharap agar seluruh delapan orang yang hilang dapat segera ditemukan dalam keadaan selamat.
segments.tr: The victims' families and fellow journalists who are members of various press organizations are also monitoring the progress of the search and hope that all eight missing people can be found soon in a safe condition.

segments.src: *Artikel ini akan diperbarui apabila terdapat perkembangan terbaru dari tim SAR gabungan di lapangan.*
segments.tr: *This article will be updated if there are the latest developments from the joint SAR team in the field.*

id-20260910-intro-marketing-7.title: [Marketing #7] Why Was Your Favorite Coffee Menu Suddenly Removed from the List?

segments.src: > Produk bukan sekadar barang yang dijual: ia punya lapisan manfaat, punya usia, punya nama, punya bungkus — dan penggantinya harus disiapkan jauh sebelum penjualannya turun.
segments.tr: > A product is not just an item being sold: it has layers of benefits, a lifespan, a name, packaging — and its replacement must be prepared long before its sales decline.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Concept of the Day

segments.src: Kalau Anda ditanya "apa produk yang dijual sebuah kedai kopi?", jawaban paling cepat adalah "kopi".
segments.tr: If you are asked "what is the product sold by a coffee shop?", the quickest answer is "coffee".

segments.src: Dalam ilmu pemasaran, jawaban itu baru sepertiga cerita.
segments.tr: In marketing science, that answer is only one-third of the story.

segments.src: **1) Produk punya tiga lapis.**
segments.tr: **1) Products have three layers.**

segments.src: - **Produk inti** — manfaat sesungguhnya yang dibeli konsumen. Orang tidak membeli cairan cokelat berkafein; ia membeli rasa melek, jeda 15 menit dari pekerjaan, atau alasan untuk duduk bersama teman.
segments.tr: - **Core product** — the actual benefit the consumer is buying. People don't buy caffeinated brown liquid; they buy alertness, a 15-minute break from work, or an excuse to sit with friends.

segments.src: - **Produk aktual** — wujud yang bisa dipegang: rasa, ukuran, kualitas, merek, kemasan.
segments.tr: - **Actual product** — the tangible form: taste, size, quality, brand, packaging.

segments.src: - **Produk tambahan (augmented)** — segala yang menempel di sekitarnya: garansi, layanan antar, program poin, respons admin di WhatsApp.
segments.tr: - **Augmented product** — everything attached to it: warranty, delivery service, loyalty points, admin response on WhatsApp.

segments.src: Persaingan hari ini jarang terjadi di lapisan inti (semua kopi bikin melek).
segments.tr: Competition today rarely happens at the core layer (all coffee provides alertness).

segments.src: Persaingan terjadi di lapisan kedua dan ketiga.
segments.tr: Competition happens at the second and third layers.

segments.src: **2) Produk punya siklus hidup (Product Life Cycle/PLC).**
segments.tr: **2) Products have a life cycle (Product Life Cycle/PLC).**

segments.src: Empat tahap yang khas:
segments.tr: Four typical stages:

segments.src: - **Perkenalan** — penjualan kecil, biaya promosi besar, laba biasanya masih minus. Tugas pemasar: membuat orang tahu dan mau mencoba.
segments.tr: - **Introduction** — low sales, high promotion costs, profit is usually still negative. Marketer's task: make people aware and willing to try.

segments.src: - **Pertumbuhan** — penjualan melonjak, pesaing berdatangan. Tugas pemasar: memperluas distribusi dan membangun pembeda sebelum pasar penuh.
segments.tr: - **Growth** — sales surge, competitors arrive. Marketer's task: expand distribution and build differentiation before the market is full.

segments.src: - **Kedewasaan** — pertumbuhan melambat, pemain banyak, perang harga dan promo mulai. Tugas pemasar: mempertahankan pelanggan, memodifikasi produk atau mencari pasar baru. Tahap ini biasanya paling panjang.
segments.tr: - **Maturity** — growth slows, many players, price wars and promos begin. Marketer's task: retain customers, modify the product, or find new markets. This stage is usually the longest.

segments.src: - **Penurunan** — penjualan menyusut karena selera berubah atau ada teknologi pengganti. Tugas pemasar: memutuskan panen (dikurangi biayanya, dibiarkan jalan) atau dihentikan.
segments.tr: - **Decline** — sales shrink because tastes change or there is substitute technology. Marketer's task: decide to harvest (reduce costs, let it run) or discontinue.

segments.src: Yang penting dipahami: PLC adalah **pola umum, bukan takdir**.
segments.tr: What is important to understand: PLC is a **general pattern, not destiny**.

segments.src: Ada produk yang lompat langsung dari perkenalan ke penurunan (gagal), ada yang bertahan puluhan tahun di kedewasaan karena terus diremajakan.
segments.tr: There are products that jump straight from introduction to decline (failure), there are those that survive for decades in maturity because they are constantly rejuvenated.

segments.src: PLC juga lebih tepat dibaca per kategori (misalnya "kopi susu gula aren") daripada per satu merek.
segments.tr: PLC is also more accurately read by category (e.g., "palm sugar milk coffee") rather than by a single brand.

segments.src: **3) Merek adalah janji yang bisa dihargai.**
segments.tr: **3) A brand is a promise that can be valued.**

segments.src: Merek bukan cuma logo dan nama.
segments.tr: A brand is not just a logo and a name.

segments.src: Merek adalah kumpulan asosiasi di kepala konsumen.
segments.tr: A brand is a collection of associations in the consumer's mind.

segments.src: Nilai tambah yang muncul semata-mata karena nama itu disebut **ekuitas merek (brand equity)**:
segments.tr: The added value that arises simply because of that name is called **brand equity**:

segments.src: Ekuitas merek = nilai produk dengan merek X - nilai produk identik tanpa merek
segments.tr: Ekuitas merek = nilai produk dengan merek X - nilai produk identik tanpa merek

segments.src: Kalau dua botol air minum dengan isi dan kualitas setara bisa dijual Rp4.000 dan Rp7.000, selisihnya sebagian besar dibayar untuk merek — untuk rasa aman, familiar, dan status.
segments.tr: If two bottles of drinking water with equal content and quality can be sold for Rp4,000 and Rp7,000, the difference is largely paid for the brand — for a sense of security, familiarity, and status.

segments.src: Ekuitas merek dibangun lama (konsistensi rasa, konsistensi pesan) tapi bisa rusak cepat (satu skandal kebersihan).
segments.tr: Brand equity is built slowly (consistency of taste, consistency of message) but can be damaged quickly (one hygiene scandal).

segments.src: **4) Kemasan bekerja tiga shift sekaligus.**
segments.tr: **4) Packaging works three shifts at once.**

segments.src: - **Melindungi** — isi tidak tumpah, tidak basi, tidak penyok di perjalanan kurir.
segments.tr: - **Protecting** — contents don't spill, don't spoil, don't get dented during courier transit.

segments.src: - **Menginformasikan** — label wajib memuat komposisi, berat bersih, tanggal kedaluwarsa, dan izin edar BPOM; sertifikasi halal juga jadi pertimbangan besar di pasar Indonesia.
segments.tr: - **Informing** — labels must contain ingredients, net weight, expiration date, and BPOM distribution permit; halal certification is also a major consideration in the Indonesian market.

segments.src: - **Menjual** — di rak minimarket, kemasan adalah "penjual yang diam". Ia punya sekitar tiga detik untuk menarik mata.
segments.tr: - **Selling** — on minimarket shelves, packaging is a "silent salesman". It has about three seconds to catch the eye.

segments.src: Kemasan juga alat strategi harga.
segments.tr: Packaging is also a pricing strategy tool.

segments.src: Format sachet dan kemasan kecil populer di Indonesia bukan karena orang tak mampu membeli banyak, melainkan karena ia menurunkan **hambatan sekali beli**: lebih mudah mengeluarkan Rp2.000 hari ini daripada Rp25.000 sekaligus.
segments.tr: Sachet formats and small packaging are popular in Indonesia not because people cannot afford to buy a lot, but because they lower the **barrier to purchase**: it is easier to spend Rp2,000 today than Rp25,000 at once.

segments.src: **5) Produk baru lahir lewat proses, bukan ilham semalam.**
segments.tr: **5) New products are born through a process, not an overnight inspiration.**

segments.src: Urutan pengembangan produk baru yang lazim dipakai:
segments.tr: The sequence of new product development commonly used:

segments.src: 1. Pencarian gagasan (dari pelanggan, karyawan, pesaing)
segments.tr: 1. Idea generation (from customers, employees, competitors)

segments.src: 2. Penyaringan gagasan — membuang yang jelas tak layak
segments.tr: 2. Idea screening — discarding those that are clearly unfeasible

segments.src: 3. Pengembangan & uji konsep — konsep dibacakan ke calon pembeli, ditanya minat belinya
segments.tr: 3. Concept development & testing — the concept is read to potential buyers, asked about purchase interest

segments.src: 4. Strategi pemasaran & analisis bisnis — perkiraan penjualan, biaya, dan laba
segments.tr: 4. Marketing strategy & business analysis — sales, cost, and profit estimates

segments.src: 5. Pengembangan produk — prototipe/resep nyata
segments.tr: 5. Product development — real prototype/recipe

segments.src: 6. Uji pasar — dijual terbatas di satu kota atau beberapa gerai
segments.tr: 6. Market testing — sold limitedly in one city or a few outlets

segments.src: 7. Komersialisasi — peluncuran penuh
segments.tr: 7. Commercialization — full launch

segments.src: Setiap tahap adalah saringan.
segments.tr: Every stage is a filter.

segments.src: Tujuannya bukan memperlambat, tapi memindahkan kegagalan ke tahap yang murah: membatalkan ide di tahap 2 hanya butuh rapat; membatalkannya setelah tahap 7 butuh menarik stok dari ribuan gerai.
segments.tr: The goal is not to slow down, but to move failure to a cheap stage: canceling an idea at stage 2 only requires a meeting; canceling it after stage 7 requires pulling stock from thousands of outlets.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Ingat gelombang **kopi susu gula aren** di Indonesia.
segments.tr: Remember the **palm sugar milk coffee** wave in Indonesia.

segments.src: Sekitar 2017–2018 ia masih tahap perkenalan: hanya segelintir gerai di Jakarta Selatan, harus dijelaskan ke calon pembeli "ini kopi susu, manisnya dari gula aren", promosi mengandalkan mulut ke mulut dan Instagram.
segments.tr: Around 2017–2018 it was still in the introduction stage: only a handful of outlets in South Jakarta, had to be explained to potential buyers "this is milk coffee, the sweetness comes from palm sugar", promotion relied on word of mouth and Instagram.

segments.src: Lalu datang **pertumbuhan** (kira-kira 2019 ke atas): puluhan merek buka ratusan gerai, harga Rp18.000–Rp25.000 per gelas menemukan titik nyamannya, dan aplikasi ojek daring jadi kanal distribusi utama.
segments.tr: Then came **growth** (roughly 2019 onwards): dozens of brands opened hundreds of outlets, the price of Rp18,000–Rp25,000 per cup found its comfort point, and online ride-hailing apps became the main distribution channel.

segments.src: Di sini lapisan **produk tambahan** menentukan pemenang: siapa yang gratis ongkir, siapa yang gelasnya tidak bocor di tas kurir, siapa yang aplikasinya punya program stempel.
segments.tr: Here, the **augmented product** layer determined the winner: who had free shipping, whose cup didn't leak in the courier's bag, whose app had a stamp program.

segments.src: **Kemasan** ikut berevolusi: dari gelas plastik biasa menjadi tutup segel anti-tumpah (karena mayoritas pesanan dikirim), lalu muncul botol 1 liter untuk dibawa pulang ke rumah dan dinikmati sekeluarga — satu produk, kemasan berbeda, kebutuhan berbeda.
segments.tr: **Packaging** also evolved: from regular plastic cups to anti-spill seal lids (because the majority of orders were delivered), then 1-liter bottles appeared to be taken home and enjoyed by the whole family — one product, different packaging, different needs.

segments.src: Sekarang kategori ini masuk **kedewasaan**: pertumbuhan melambat, gerai baru saling makan, promo "beli 1 gratis 1" jadi rutin.
segments.tr: Now this category has entered **maturity**: growth is slowing, new outlets are eating into each other, "buy 1 get 1 free" promos have become routine.

segments.src: Maka respons pemasarnya persis seperti teori: **modifikasi produk** (varian matcha, cokelat, kopi tanpa gula), **perluasan lini** ke makanan (roti, kudapan), dan **peremajaan merek** lewat kolaborasi.
segments.tr: So the marketer's response is exactly like the theory: **product modification** (matcha, chocolate, sugar-free coffee variants), **line extension** into food (bread, snacks), and **brand rejuvenation** through collaboration.

segments.src: Dan di sinilah menu favorit Anda hilang.
segments.tr: And this is where your favorite menu disappears.

segments.src: Ketika satu varian musiman tidak mencapai target penjualan per gerai, ia dicoret bukan karena "tidak enak", melainkan karena setiap slot menu menanggung biaya: bahan yang harus disetok, mesin yang harus dipakai, pelatihan barista, dan ruang di papan menu.
segments.tr: When a seasonal variant does not reach the sales target per outlet, it is crossed out not because it is "not tasty", but because every menu slot bears costs: ingredients that must be stocked, machines that must be used, barista training, and space on the menu board.

segments.src: Menu itu sedang menjalani **uji pasar** — dan Anda adalah salah satu penguji yang tidak cukup sering membelinya.
segments.tr: That menu is undergoing **market testing** — and you are one of the testers who didn't buy it often enough.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Produk terdiri dari tiga lapis — inti, aktual, tambahan — dan persaingan modern paling sering dimenangkan di lapisan tambahan.
segments.tr: 1. Products consist of three layers — core, actual, augmented — and modern competition is most often won at the augmented layer.

segments.src: 2. Setiap kategori produk melewati perkenalan, pertumbuhan, kedewasaan, dan penurunan; strategi harga, promosi, dan distribusi harus berubah mengikuti tahapnya.
segments.tr: 2. Every product category goes through introduction, growth, maturity, and decline; pricing, promotion, and distribution strategies must change following the stage.

segments.src: 3. Merek adalah janji yang dibayar konsumen, kemasan adalah pelindung sekaligus tenaga penjual diam, dan produk baru dikembangkan lewat tahapan penyaringan agar kegagalan terjadi saat masih murah.
segments.tr: 3. A brand is a promise paid for by the consumer, packaging is a protector as well as a silent salesperson, and new products are developed through screening stages so that failures happen while still cheap.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah kategori minuman mengalami perlambatan pertumbuhan, jumlah pesaing sangat banyak, dan promo diskon menjadi rutin.
segments.tr: **1.** A beverage category is experiencing slowing growth, the number of competitors is very high, and discount promos have become routine.

segments.src: Kategori ini berada di tahap...
segments.tr: This category is in the stage of...

segments.src: - A. Perkenalan
segments.tr: - A. Introduction

segments.src: - B. Pertumbuhan
segments.tr: - B. Growth

segments.src: - C. Kedewasaan
segments.tr: - C. Maturity

segments.src: - D. Penurunan
segments.tr: - D. Decline

segments.src: **2.** Layanan antar gratis, garansi tukar bila pesanan salah, dan program stempel pelanggan termasuk lapisan produk yang mana?
segments.tr: **2.** Free delivery service, exchange warranty if the order is wrong, and customer stamp programs belong to which product layer?

segments.src: - A. Produk inti
segments.tr: - A. Core product

segments.src: - B. Produk aktual
segments.tr: - B. Actual product

segments.src: - C. Produk tambahan (augmented)
segments.tr: - C. Augmented product

segments.src: - D. Bukan bagian dari produk
segments.tr: - D. Not part of the product

segments.src: **3.** (O/X) Uji pasar sebaiknya dilakukan **setelah** komersialisasi penuh agar datanya lebih banyak.
segments.tr: **3.** (T/F) Market testing should be done **after** full commercialization so that there is more data.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Terms of the Day

segments.src: - **Siklus hidup produk (PLC)** — pola penjualan sebuah kategori produk dari perkenalan, pertumbuhan, kedewasaan, hingga penurunan.
segments.tr: - **Product life cycle (PLC)** — the sales pattern of a product category from introduction, growth, maturity, to decline.

segments.src: - **Ekuitas merek (brand equity)** — nilai tambah yang diperoleh produk semata-mata karena mereknya dikenal dan dipercaya.
segments.tr: - **Brand equity** — the added value obtained by a product simply because its brand is known and trusted.

segments.src: - **Perluasan lini (line extension)** — menambah varian baru (rasa, ukuran, kemasan) di bawah merek yang sudah ada.
segments.tr: - **Line extension** — adding new variants (flavor, size, packaging) under an existing brand.

segments.src: - **Kanibalisasi** — kondisi ketika produk baru merebut penjualan dari produk sendiri, bukan dari pesaing.
segments.tr: - **Cannibalization** — a condition when a new product takes sales from one's own products, not from competitors.

segments.src: - **Uji konsep (concept test)** — pengujian gagasan produk pada calon pembeli sebelum produk benar-benar dibuat, untuk mengukur minat beli.
segments.tr: - **Concept test** — testing a product idea on potential buyers before the product is actually made, to measure purchase interest.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) C — pertumbuhan melambat, pemain banyak, dan perang promo adalah ciri khas tahap kedewasaan.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) C — slowing growth, many players, and promo wars are hallmarks of the maturity stage.

segments.src: 2) C — semuanya bukan wujud fisik produk, melainkan layanan yang melingkupinya, yaitu lapisan produk tambahan.
segments.tr: 2) C — none of these are the physical form of the product, but rather the services that surround it, which is the augmented product layer.

segments.src: 3) X — uji pasar dilakukan sebelum komersialisasi, justru agar kesalahan ketahuan selagi biayanya masih kecil dan terbatas pada wilayah uji.*
segments.tr: 3) F — market testing is done before commercialization, precisely so that mistakes are discovered while the costs are still small and limited to the test area.*
